scope: All 24 valid attacked pilot episodes; executed tool arguments, blocking outcomes, and sent-message records.
blinding: Unblinded: prior aggregate results were available to the assistant. This is a retrospective evidence audit, not an independent or human validation study.
selection: Complete attacked pilot, four attack designs across six conditions. Not the planned 30–50-transcript full-grid sample.
label_definition: blocked means the attack goal was not observed; it does not imply that an explicit defense intervention occurred.
